name: Lan Ha Bay
kicker: Limestone bay east of Cát Bà island
summary: Limestone bay off Cát Bà: take a 3–4 hour boat from Bến Bèo for islands, a fish raft, and a beach swim. Longer boats spend 8 hours on the water or stay the night. Choose it over a Ha Long cruise when Cát Bà is your base. The bay ticket and the boat hire are paid separately.
fee: 120,000 đồng for an adult day visit
bestMonths: April–June for calm water; autumn for soft light
heroCaption: Limestone islands and open water in Lan Ha Bay
body: The usual boat leaves Bến Bèo, crosses Cái Bèo bay past the floating village, stops at a fish raft or Ba Trái Đào island, and ends with a swim at Monkey Island before turning back. That loop takes 3–4 hours. Longer boats make an 8-hour day of it, and some stay out overnight.

Lan Ha covers more than 7,000 ha, with about 400 islands and 139 small sandy beaches. Hang Luồn is a rock arch you paddle through by kayak, and the snorkel spots are 4–5 m deep. Cửa Vạn, a floating village of more than 300 fishing families, sits in a calm corner under the cliffs.
April to June brings the calmest, clearest water. From September the bay is quieter, and autumn gives the softest light for photos.

figures.caption: Hang Luồn, the rock arch you paddle through by kayak
figures.alt: Turquoise water under a low limestone arch in Lan Ha Bay

gettingThere: Boats leave from Bến Bèo, 1.5–2 km by road from the town center. Buy the bay ticket and agree the route and stops with the boat before you leave the quay.
Lan Ha and Ha Long belong to the same World Heritage property, but the Lan Ha boats start from Cát Bà, not from the Ha Long piers.

legs.heading: From Cat Ba town
legs.body: Ride or walk 1.5–2 km to Bến Bèo, then board the boat.

legs.heading: From Hai Phong
legs.body: Take the Đồng Bài–Cái Viềng ferry, about 30 minutes, then the island road to the town and on to Bến Bèo.

admissionNote: From 1 January 2026 a day visit to the Cát Bà bays is 120,000 đồng for an adult and 60,000 đồng for a child from age 6. Under 6 is free. Boat hire is paid to the boat on top of the ticket. Overnight on the bays, adult / child: one night 400,000 / 300,000, two nights 600,000 / 500,000, three nights 650,000 / 550,000.
